status: Expected contract frozen before execution; derived from the business agreement discussed in this conversation, not observed test outputs

quota.daily: Local calendar midnight; term duration <= one calendar day receives one allocation only
quota.monthly: 30*24 hours from subscription activation anchor, independent of calendar month length
quota.boundary: New period includes exact reset instant; subscription and add-on invalid at exact expiry
quota.active_renewal: Extend previous expiry; preserve start, windows and usage
quota.expired_renewal: New term starts at renewal instant; usage zero; periodic anchor renewal instant
quota.addon: Use after base quota exhaustion; purchase snapshot expiry does not extend on renewal
quota.idempotency: Same order/request ID applies once; distinct IDs apply independently even with same amount
quota.accounting: Known fixed amounts, decimal reference amounts; absolute tolerance 0.000001 USD
quota.cross_boundary_accounting: For controlled ordering, bills committed before reset belong to old window; bills admitted after completed reset belong to new window. Unordered race is checked for an admissible serial ordering; no assertion of request-start attribution.

sse.complete: Expected text plus Anthropic message_stop; HTTP 200 or ping alone insufficient
sse.first_content: First text_delta only, excluding ping and protocol metadata
